profile.headline: Staff Engineer at Boats Group
profile.summary: I wrote my first line of code at early age in BASIC. Developed a love for graphic design, printing and publishing. In 1997 entered the world wide web. From the days of CGI to the current SPA I've been learning and adapting to new technologies. I like the outdoors. Reading a book at night. A good meal with wine and friends. And work in a friendly, creative space.

Lead Software Engineer at Boats Group
Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
Project Leader at MPEG-DASH HTML5 Video Player
Develop Front End, UI features and tooling across all the products at blim.
Usually with ES6, node.js and Angular.

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
I Designed a software to production delivery process (DevOp like process):
- Leverage git and github to provide developers and non-developers with a platform for discussion and agile-like development process
- Create a continuous deployment flow in Microsoft's Azure implementing three environments: -Development, Staging and Production.
- Develop the tooling for automatic testing and building the apps in carsmart.io (Generate, optimize and minimize assets with gulp, tests with Mocha, Chai, Karma and Protractor)

And I also designed and developed the Front-End for carsmart.io web application including a "mini transpiler" using ESCodegen and ASTTypes to translate JS to a DSL and backwards :

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: I develop new features in several languages.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
I developed new features on neurs.com and neurs.net. My most prominent projects were:
- Neurs.com Dashboard, exposing previously hidden content to the users, resulting in a 30% increment of User Engaging. I developed a REST API in php and javascript (vainilla & jquery) in client side.
- Neurs.net payment framework using Node (ES6) with Koa.js, paypal - Braintree libraries & Angular (JavaScript 5) in Client Side.

positions.title: Profesor
positions.description: I lead students to fulfill World-class, web standard-based, multimedia projects. I developed the curricula and teach theoretical classes and tutored team and individual projects. The environment essentially was Adobe suite applications (Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Flash, Adobe In-Design & Adobe Dreamweaver) and PHP, HTML, Javascript as platform technologies.

positions.title: Director Creativo
positions.description:
I did graphic user interface design, web design and programming. Among the projects I did, were: 
Video dubbing production English to Spanish for Pfizer Venezuela. Executive Producer. I lead a team of 1 sound engineer, 5 voice talents and 2 editors.
Argos. Bulk Cargo control and verification system built in Pyhton 2.5 -Django 1.3

positions.title: Attaché Gerencia de Proyecto
positions.description:
Comunication Management at Carabobo Chapter in all projects and electoral events during the time served. Prominent Project: 
Primary Elections Mesa de la Unidad 2012. Data driven state wide publication listing electoral center using Python 2.7, Adobe In-Design & XML.

positions.title: Administrador de Sistemas
positions.description: Mantenimiento y expansión de la red informática del Centro de Estudios Gerenciales y núcleo de UNITEC en Valencia.
